hints.title: Subproblem Structure
hints.text: Let optimal prefix cost state[i] be the minimum cost to construct the target prefix of length i.

hints.title: Word Length Bucketing
hints.text: The number of unique word lengths in words is bounded by sqrt(total_word_length) <= 220.

hints.title: Prefix Transitions
hints.text: For each distinct length L, look up the target suffix target[i - L : i] in a hash map of minimal costs for words of length L.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouping by length bounds transitions to sqrt(W) per prefix position.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all words at every index takes O(n * len(words)) causing TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(W) hash map storage for words.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the square root bound on distinct word lengths and optimize suffix transitions.
